title: Method for Simultaneous Wing Aerodynamic and Structural Load Prediction
author: Mark Drela
source_role: Primary author paper, fetched from a public mirror. ASWING 3.x as identified by the official manual; not proof of ASWING 5.x defaults.
current_discrete_point_loads: Drela2015 pp13–15, Eqs55–56; exact jump represented by separate element-sided resultants at the shared physical node.
native_plot_scope: ST4 7c and AE6 7a Xplot11 M/L strokes reviewed. They are complex-eigenvalue plots with partial operating-point legends, not node-coordinate diagrams.
